text:
emily: Heads-up: uploaded a small mock for the trace viewer Request Context panel — proposing to move the Export action out of the top header into the kebab menu (to reduce header clutter) and add an inline ‘Copy correlation ID’ button next to the stacktrace. Thoughts? :thinking: @javi @aria https://redwood.design/mockups/1767894321.png
javi: Quick feasibility check — moving export to the kebab is fine. Two backend caveats: 1) we need to be explicit about what "Export request" includes (current request + attachments vs full trace), and 2) if users expect export to include related spans we need to bundle them. For the Copy correlation ID, should we copy trace_id:span_id or just trace_id? both are possible but mixing may confuse integrators.
sam: Agree with kebab move. UX suggestion: label the export action clearly like "Export trace (.zip)" or "Export request (current)" so expectations are clear. Also, for large traces we should surface a size estimate or a warning (eg >10MB) before starting an export.
aria: Accessibility notes: use aria-label="Copy correlation identifier" (avoid ambiguous 'ID'). Add visually-hidden helper text that explains the format ("trace id is 32 hex chars"). Ensure the copy button is keyboard-focusable and announce success via aria-live region ("Correlation ID copied"). Also flag color contrast on the mock — the current link-blue on white at 12px doesn't meet AA, bump weight or change to darker tone.
emily: Thanks — I'll iterate. Quick UX question: for the copy button tooltip, do we show the full id on hover or show a truncated preview with an explicit "Show full" option? I'm leaning truncated + expand to avoid huge clipboard previews on hover.
javi: Truncated + expand seems reasonable. Backend note: trace_id is 32 hex chars and span_id is 16 hex chars — client-side expansion is trivial. Implementation snippet for reference: `navigator.clipboard.writeText(trace_id + ':' + span_id)` (wrap in try/catch and fallback to selecting a hidden input).
deploy-bot: Preview deployed: https://redwood.design/previews/1767894321 — feedback window open for 48h :calendar:
